name: QSC_PROD_GRP_REL_B
description: This table maintains the relationship between product groups. Used for creating a product group hierarchy by associating one product group to another.

columns.name: PROD_GRP_REL_ID
columns.description: Product Group Relationship Identifier. Primary Key.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Parent Product Group Identifier. Foreign Key to QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B

columns.name: REL_PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Related Child Product Group Identifier. Foreign Key to QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B

columns.name: RELATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Defines relationship type between product groups.

columns.name: REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Revision Number

columns.name: CHANGE_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used internally for publishing product groups.

columns.name: REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier used for integration with external systems.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Persistent Id used to reference the original version.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the related group relationship is active.

columns.name: UI_COLLAPSE_FLAG
columns.description: Set this flag to indicate that the intermediate child category will be collapsed and the contents of the intermediate category will be directly displayed under the parent category.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the related group relationship is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date after which the related group relationship is not active.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER_NUM
columns.description: Manually set display order for related groups in a product group.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
